references.text: This song shall be a witness against the children of Israel; it is the same song mentioned in verse 21.
Moses' song, which will serve as a witness against the people when disaster strikes them, just as foretold.
God knows the rebellious nature and inclinations of the people, which have existed since He first knew them.
God knows the thoughts and inclinations of the human heart (יֵצֶר), which are evil from youth.
The inclination of the human heart (יֵצֶר) is evil from youth, something God knows.
The Lord knows our formation and that we are dust; He understands the nature of humanity.
God declares from the beginning what will come to pass; He knows the future and human actions beforehand.
God knows Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from Him; He knows the ways and inclinations of the people.
Jesus knew all people and understood what was in man—parallel to God's knowledge of humanity's inner nature.
No creature is hidden from God; everything lies naked and exposed before His eyes; He knows all.
